summary: Applies 2D image transforms including translate, rotate, scale, pivot, background fill, alpha premultiply options, and repeated or mirrored tiling.

key_params.name: premultrgbbyalpha
key_params.note: Premultiply RGB by alpha before compositing

key_params.name: compover
key_params.note: Composite transformed pixels over the background

key_params.name: mipmapbias
key_params.note: Bias mipmap level used for filtered input textures

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Hold, zero, repeat, or mirror tile edges

key_params.name: limittiles
key_params.note: Limit repeated tiles to configured U/V ranges

key_params.name: tileu
key_params.note: Horizontal tile range when limiting tiles

key_params.name: tilev
key_params.note: Vertical tile range when limiting tiles

common_gotchas: Transform order changes the final image position; do not assume translate/rotate/scale commute.
Pivot units and translate units matter when mixing normalized, pixel, and aspect-based controls.
Grow/Shrink is a pixel-unit scale offset, not the same control as normalized Scale.
Comp Over changes how alpha-less-than-one areas combine with the background color.
Repeat/mirror tiles are only visible when scale/translate exposes areas beyond the original image.
key_concepts: Transform TOP applies 2D translate, rotate, scale, pivot, and pixel grow/shrink operations to an image.
The transform order menu is non-commutative, so changing xord changes the visual result.
Background color, alpha premultiplication, and composite-over controls determine how exposed or translucent pixels are filled.
Extend and tile-limit controls can repeat or mirror the transformed image into newly exposed regions.
